name: Ferienwohnung Pemberger
beschreibung:
Peacefully set in the Haflinger village of Ebbs, the Pemberger family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth in a cosy apartment for couples and families.

Highlights such as the Fohlenhof stud farm, the Kaiser valley, and the Hallo du leisure centre are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Pemberger in Ebbs offers warm family hospitality and mountain views in Kufsteinerland.
